output.plan: Find the semester with the latest start_date, even if it has no grades yet, then average the non-NULL enrollment grades in that semester (AVG skips NULLs). The result also returns the semester name so the figure is labeled.
output.sql: SELECT s.name AS semester, AVG(e.grade) AS average_grade FROM enrollments e JOIN course_offerings co ON e.offering_id = co.id JOIN semesters s ON co.semester_id = s.id WHERE s.start_date = (SELECT MAX(start_date) FROM semesters) GROUP BY s.id, s.name
